reuse.why: Uses ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, findOrCreateBank and handleSyncResponse, but copies the per-provider link body, the Akahu downloader and the Akahu balance branch instead of sharing them.

duplication.why: Three blocks are duplicated: linkFintegraAccount copies the provider link handlers, downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions, and the fintegra balance branch in processBankSyncDownload copies the akahu branch verbatim.

placement.why: Each piece lands where the tree keeps that provider logic: accounts/app.ts, accounts/sync.ts, server-config.ts and types/models.

scope.why: Only Fintegra server support and its tests.

maintainability.why: Adds another full copy of linking, download and balance logic, and the trimmed download copy already drifts from Akahu's (no connection-error branch, no timeout).
